title: Lich Equips More Spells
description: A skeletal lich-like figure with multiple arms sits atop a mound of bones and gold rings, holding an open book, an hourglass, a bone wand, and a snake. Smaller human figures kneel and worship around the base while golden halos and magical symbols float above in a dark, swirling background.
prompt: A multi-armed skeletal lich wearing dark robes and golden jewelry sits on a throne of bones and scattered golden rings, holding an open spellbook in one hand, an hourglass in another, a bone wand, and a snake. Smaller human figures kneel in worship at its base. Golden halos float above its skull, magical symbols and swirling smoke fill the dark background with dramatic lighting and glowing orbs.
